Camila: Quick sync — finalizing INC-834 postmortem actions. Can owners confirm who owns which item and due dates? I'll compile for the RCA doc.
Arjun: I can take action 1 (rate-limit fallback config). Due 2025-01-20. I'll post the config diff when ready.
Sofia: Ack — I'll own action 2 (canary routing rule + rollout plan). Target finish 2025-01-22; will propose canary windows.
Riley: I'll own action 3 (metrics + traces to console). ETA 2025-01-18. Opening a PR and will ping for CR.
Camila: Thanks — please add your owner lines to the postmortem doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/INC-834 (under "actions").
Jesse: Heads up I'm blocked on infra quota for a dedicated pool which might block Arjun's rollout step. Who's the infra contact?
Arjun: I saw an earlier quota ticket but no update. @inc-bot any status?
inc-bot: Ticket #Q-4921 created for infra quota, priority P2, assigned to infra-team.
Sofia: Ops replied in the ticket: low-risk quota approvals should land by EOD Mon 2025-01-15.
Riley: PR opened for metrics: `github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1234` — requesting review from @Jesse and @Camila.
Jesse: I'll review tomorrow morning and call out any blocking changes.
Camila: Also need an owner for action 4 (retry-backfill for failed requests). Who can take it?
Arjun: I can lead the backfill work but will need a pairing partner for integration tests. @Sofia can you pair on test coverage?
Sofia: Yep, I can pair. We can split test harness + backfill script. Proposed ETA 2025-01-25.
Camila: Please confirm exact due dates in-thread so I can mark them in the tracker.
Arjun: Confirmed — action 1 due 2025-01-20.
Sofia: Confirmed — action 2 due 2025-01-22; action 4 (backfill tests + script) due 2025-01-25, pairing with Arjun.
Riley: Confirmed — action 3 due 2025-01-18; PR #1234 opened and labeled `inc-834`.
Jesse: I'll do PR review by 2025-01-16 and help expedite infra quota if it still blocks rollout.
Camila: Perfect. I'll update the RCA doc and the tracker; will ping PMs for final closure after verification.
Sofia: One more ask: I'll draft a short rollback play for the routing change (action 2) and share by 2025-01-21.
Arjun: +1 on the rollback doc. Good to have.
Camila: Thanks all :thumbsup: — rolling these into the postmortem and scheduling a follow-up check-in.
Riley: Leaving a sticker :rocket:
inc-bot: Reminder scheduled: postmortem follow-up check-in on 2025-01-26 15:00 UTC.
